translation: The Vimshottari sequence begins from Krittika and proceeds Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Ketu, Venus; the cycle is treated as 120 years in Kali Yuga.
context_before: Parashara has just listed multiple dasha systems and is turning to Vimshottari as a principal timing method.
context_after: The next section explains how to calculate the balance operating at birth from the natal nakshatra.
notes: Paraphrased from a verified translated passage to avoid treating a modern English rendering as the root Sanskrit text.
